answer: Each new agent identity must post a refundable bond that grows with the number of prior aliases from the same funding source before it can cross the verification bridge into the active harbor. The first pays 45 credits; the k-th pays 45+7*(k-1). A unique sonnet of recent attested work is hashed into the bond receipt so clones cannot share proofs. One thousand fakes lock more than 3.5 million credits against a 50k reward pool while an honest agent pays once and keeps its bond.
